payload.blocks: Only phase 7 and the plan's done; phase 7 is landed on main (9fd188d74) and phase 5 waits separately on q-4lmw3q6la7.
payload.headline: Who runs the component-authority plan's full-suite gate on the host, since every sandbox here cannot?

parts.cause: npm test must take the full-suite lock under ~/.local/state/fgos/locks, which is read-only in every confined head and unit, the supervisor's included; the cargo reds judge host process liveness, which a PID namespace hides. Same situation as the open q-zcileomdpa: one host run on current main answers both.

options.cost: One host run plus one lead pass.
options.does: On the host, run npm test and cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast once on current main and drop both logs under plans/261121-2109-component-authority/reports/ (the same run can also go to the heads-rotate reports for q-zcileomdpa); the lead classifies reds and closes phase 7.
options.gain: Acceptance 5 proven for real; the confinement reds get a verdict.
options.harm: About 15 minutes of host suite time, shared with q-zcileomdpa.
options.label: Host run by the owner

options.does: Close phase 7 on the sandbox cargo run and the acceptance 1-4 checks, with npm test unrun and the reds recorded as sandbox reds.
options.harm: A real red would go unowned; npm test never ran on the tree without the manifest.
options.label: Accept the sandbox gate

parts.recommendation: Host run, as for q-zcileomdpa and q-vgwalbohwj: the sandbox cannot tell real reds from sandbox ones and cannot run npm test at all.

scope.allows: One host full-suite run on current main and the lead classifying reds in the plan's integration report.
scope.forbids: Fixing any red outside this plan's footprint, or skipping checks with env switches.

parts.what: Acceptance 5 needs npm test and cargo test --workspace green on main at or after 9fd188d74. Acceptance 1 to 4 pass (plans/261121-2109-component-authority/reports/integration-261123-0427-component-authority-acceptance.md). In the lead's sandbox, npm test did not start and cargo showed 8 confinement/gateway reds outside this plan's files.
